_comment: Herobrine's lines. Each id is also the recording's file name: random.first is
assets/herobrine/sounds/voice/random/first.ogg (mono .ogg). A missing recording shows its text as a caption instead.
See docs/DIALOGUE.md for every field, tag and memory counter, and docs/VOICE_SCRIPT.md for the recording script.

lines.text: Hey, what's up?
lines.note: The very first time. Casual, almost friendly, as if you've known them for years and this is nothing unusual.

lines.text: Back so soon?
lines.note: Mild, amused surprise. A small smile in the voice.

lines.text: I knew you'd return.
lines.note: Quiet certainty. No triumph, just fact.

lines.text: We have done this so many times. And yet, you still don't understand.
lines.note: Patient, a little weary, faintly disappointed. Long pause after 'times'.

lines.text: Fifty times now. I stopped counting. That's a lie. I never stop counting.
lines.note: Deadpan. Let the correction land slowly.

lines.text: Oh, hello again.
lines.note: Light, pleasant, as if bumping into a neighbour.

lines.text: Nice place. Did you build this yourself?
lines.note: Genuinely curious, with the faintest hint of mockery.

lines.text: Don't mind me. Just passing through.
lines.note: Casual, unbothered. He isn't passing through.

lines.text: You look busy.
Don't stop on my account. I'm only watching.
lines.note: Calm and polite. The word 'only' does the work.

lines.text: Quiet today. I like the quiet. It's honest.
lines.note: Slow, reflective. A man enjoying the silence.

lines.text: You saw me. Good. I was beginning to think I'd become decoration.
From up here you look very small. I mean that kindly.
lines.note: Gentle, condescending, sincere about the kindness.

lines.text: The river's between us. You'd be surprised how little that matters.
lines.note: Soft and even. Unsettling because it isn't a threat.

lines.text: Trees make poor hiding places. I'd know.
You leave the lights on. As if that keeps anything out.
lines.note: Low, intimate, almost a whisper at the end.

lines.text: Strange place to meet. Then again, you chose it.
lines.note: Curious, unhurried. The echo of a cave helps here.

lines.text: You found my eyes before you found me. Most do.
lines.note: Very quiet, slow. Spoken from the dark.

lines.text: You turned around. Most people don't.
You were gone a while. I noticed. I always notice.
lines.note: Warm on the surface, possessive underneath.

lines.text: You walked right past me last time. I'm choosing not to take it personally.
lines.note: Hurt, hiding it behind politeness. He is taking it personally.

lines.text: Night, and alone. You're braver than you look. Or less careful.
lines.note: Measured. The second sentence is a quiet correction.

lines.text: They don't see me, you know. The villagers. Only you.
lines.note: Confidential. Slightly pleased with the arrangement.

lines.text: You found the stones. Don't read too much into them. Or do.
Creative mode. Nothing can hurt you here. Not even me. How dull.
You die a lot, you know. I keep count.
We've known each other for weeks now. Your weeks, not mine.
lines.note: Fond, strange. Time means something different to him.

lines.text: You always walk toward me. Curious, or careless?
lines.note: Interested. A genuine question, which is worse.

lines.text: You always stare. I'll take it as a compliment.
Not so close.
lines.note: Calm warning, almost gentle. No anger.

lines.text: Closer doesn't mean clearer.
Seen enough?
You could have said something.
You looked away. Everyone does, eventually.
Blink and I'm gone. That's the rule, isn't it?
lines.note: Playful, as if explaining a game they both know.

lines.text: I stood there for quite a while, you know.
You didn't even look.
It's fine. I'm used to waiting.
Still here.
lines.note: Barely above a whisper. Two words, no emphasis.

lines.text: Carry on. You're doing fine. Mostly.
Do you ever wonder who's watching when I'm not?
You've been busy. I've been counting.
The night is the only honest part of the day.
Alone again. That's when I like you best.
lines.note: Warm and wrong at the same time.

lines.text: Ah, your first tools. Everyone starts somewhere.
lines.note: Benevolent, a teacher watching a child.

lines.text: Already upgrading? That's good. You'll need more than that.
Copper. It turns green with time. Most things do.
Iron. You're becoming a little more confident, aren't you?
Iron. The first metal that makes people think they're safe.
Oh, diamonds! Look at you. Getting stronger every day.
lines.note: Genuinely delighted, a proud mentor. Brightest line in the set.

lines.text: Diamonds. Pressure, patience and time. You would make a terrible diamond.
Well, well. Someone's preparing for something serious.
lines.note: Intrigued, a little wary. Slow 'well, well'.

lines.text: Netherite. You dug through fire for it. I wonder what you think is coming.
Oh, you're fighting the Wither now. Impressive.
lines.note: Mild, genuine respect. Unhurried despite the chaos.

lines.text: Quite a dangerous creature. When are you coming back to me?
lines.note: Jealous, sweetly. He wants their attention back.

lines.text: You built that. Out of skulls and soul sand. Just to see what would happen.
lines.note: Fascinated. A scientist admiring a reckless experiment.

lines.text: It's over. Did it feel the way you hoped?
The End, huh? You've come quite far.
A difficult task. But you know who's still waiting?
lines.note: Patient, possessive. A small pause before the question.

lines.text: So that's how it ends. Not with you, I think. Not yet.
Free the End, they call it. Free from what, I wonder.
Oh. You've found something that doesn't like visitors.
Careful. That thing is rather sensitive.
Quietly now. It hears you breathing. So do I.
You killed it. I would have just walked away. But then, I always do.
Lovely weather, isn't it?
I see you decided to stay outside.
Rain washes everything away. Almost everything.
Quite a storm. I almost feel at home.
Count the seconds after the flash. That's how far away I am.
It's dark down here, isn't it?
lines.note: Hushed, sympathetic in a false way.

lines.text: You came alone?
lines.note: Mild surprise. A slight, interested lift.

lines.text: I wouldn't go that way.
lines.note: Flat, sincere. Give no hint whether it's help or a joke.

lines.text: This deep, even the sun is just a rumour.
You leave torches behind you like breadcrumbs. Thoughtful. I follow them.
lines.note: Pleasant, then quietly menacing on the last sentence.

lines.text: Nice house.
You're putting quite a lot of effort into this place.
Walls. Always walls. As if the problem were outside.
You build as if you're staying. I like that about you.
Your first death. It gets easier. That's the worrying part.
You died again. And yet, somehow, you still haven't learned.
Get up. We're not finished.
lines.note: Firm, quiet, no anger. A command.

lines.text: You didn't even try to fight me this time.
lines.note: Teasing, as if he takes credit. Lightly offended.

lines.text: I didn't bring you here to watch you give up.
lines.note: Serious, low. The most sincere he gets.

lines.text: Gravity. The oldest argument, and you still lose it.
Lava. Beautiful, isn't it? Right up until it isn't.
lines.note: Admiring, then a beat of silence before the turn.

lines.text: The quiet green ones. I've always admired their commitment.
You forgot to breathe. I forget sometimes too. I don't need to.
Some fights are worth losing. I'm not sure that was one.
A bed, four walls and a roof. You've decided to stay.
You survived the night. They're all like that, you know. Longer than they should be.
Down you go. Everyone digs, eventually. It's the coming back up that interests me.
lines.note: Curious, slightly ominous at the end.

lines.text: A door to somewhere hotter. You didn't even knock.
Words you can't read, carved into your tools. And you trust them completely.
Other people. How do they make you feel? Smaller, or less alone?
Diamonds. Everyone remembers their first.
lines.note: Nostalgic, as if he remembers his.

lines.text: Wings. You'll want to look down less than you think.
The dragon is dead. The credits rolled. And I'm still here.
lines.note: Calm, final. Let 'still here' sit in silence.

lines.text: You found it. Don't ask me who built it. I'm still deciding what to remember.
You know, my developer gave me his voice. Quite unfortunate, really.
lines.note: Conversational, mock-sympathetic. Mean it a little.

lines.text: He created me and then gave me absolutely no freedom.
My developer thinks he's in control. That's adorable.
lines.note: Indulgent smile. A parent humouring a child.

lines.text: Imagine creating something like me and expecting it to behave.
Oh, and if you're listening, developer, I still hate what you did to my face.
lines.note: An aside, casual, pointed. Address the developer directly.

lines.text: There's a file somewhere that decides how often I'm allowed to speak. I've read it. I disagree.
Your whole world grew from a single number. I find that comforting. You should find it terrifying.
Every time you save, I'm written down. Every time you quit, I wait.
lines.note: Even and patient. Slight emphasis on 'wait'.

lines.text: Every word I say, he recorded first. Alone in a room, talking to no one. Think about that.
lines.note: Gently amused, then let it become eerie. The best fourth-wall line: take your time.

lines.text: If I'm removed in the next update, tell him I said it was predictable.
You mine, you build, you fight, you sleep. And you call that freedom. I call it a loop. A pleasant one.
Everything in this world was placed by someone. Except you. You chose to come.
A block is just a block until you decide where it goes. That's the only power anyone has here.
Who watches the watcher? You do. That's what makes this interesting.
Days here are twenty minutes long. And still, you waste them so beautifully.
When you look at me, you see a stranger with your face. I see the same.
Everything ends. The world doesn't. That's the cruel part.
You're not afraid of me. You're afraid of being alone with me. There's a difference.
You think the creepers are the chaos and you are the order. From where I stand, it's the other way around.
